comparison.workflow_comparison: decoder-assisted local workflow with additional declared output types and semantic field roles plus generic source-grounding system instructions; not identical-information model parity
comparison.scope: explicit_bounded_suite_only; not account credits or whole development
comparison.human_rework: not measured; checks/model reviews are not human acceptance
comparison.bootstrap_hosted_usage: excluded and unmeasured; hosted build coordinator/reviewers consume normal allowance

limitations: Mixed models, runtime policies and framing; five completed cases reused historical exact results and three fresh resource roles generated. Not one uniform fresh 18-generation run.

The resource workflow receives a manual types-only decoder contract, semantic field-role annotations and additional generic source-grounding system instructions. The same original task, canonical user prompt and answer checks are retained, but information is not identical to the baseline.
Policies were iteratively tuned on these same six fixtures. This is not held-out quality evidence or a claim that models reliably pass arbitrary tasks.
All canonical task/prompt bindings match. Actual canonical wire framing applies to fresh complex cases; historical simple cases used legacy Ollama split framing.
All original declared answer checks retained; expected answers are not sent to model roles.
Baseline input includes cache reads and output includes reasoning; these categories are not added twice.
Separate reviewer prompts share model weights and can have correlated errors. Checks and votes are not human acceptance.
Local nonstreaming elapsed time includes admission and cold starts; no TTFT or speedup established.
Operator-supplied observations, not remote attestation or representative coding quality.
No real second physical machine tested; no global chat backend changed.
Hosted build coordination/release review consumes normal allowance; whole-build tokens, account credits and USD invoice savings are excluded and unmeasured.

All current-turn failed/pending records and unknown local counters retained. The earlier v0.9.0 report remains separate and unchanged; these totals do not incorporate its unknown local usage. Hardware, electricity and time are not priced.
Outer CLI timing was not retained for the three historical simple-case origins; those fields stay null. No time values were reconstructed.
